definitions.explanation: Catching insects with a net, a classic summer pastime for Japanese children, especially hunting rhinoceros and stag beetles.

examples.japanese: {虫取|むしと}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧{虫取|むしと}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I went bug-catching every day during summer vacation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{虫取|むしと}り⟦{網|あみ}→網：22587_ami⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{虫|むし}かご→虫かご：32615_mushikago⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧、{朝早|あさはや}く⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{林|はやし}→林：01702_hayashi⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{出|で}かけた→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧。
examples.english: The children set off for the woods early in the morning with insect nets and bug cages.

notes:
Also written {虫捕|むしと}り.
